reels.caption:
A once-in-a-lifetime moment in Barcelona.
Today, the cross is being placed atop the Tower of Jesus Christ at the Sagrada Família — the tallest tower of the basilica and the crowning element of Gaudí's masterpiece. A milestone over 140 years in the making.
Only one piece remains: the Glory Façade, where Antoni Gaudí envisioned a grand garden. Today, residential buildings stand in its place. What will happen? We'll tell you all about it.
2026 marks the centenary of Gaudí's death, and at Barcelona Art of Travel we are preparing exclusive cultural programmes to help visitors connect with his extraordinary legacy.
As an Official Guide of Catalonia specialising in Gaudí and Catalan Modernism, witnessing this moment feels deeply personal.
If you work in MICE, cultural tourism or luxury travel, let's talk about how we can create something truly special for your clients this year.
📸 Photos taken today from the privilege terrace of Barcelona.
#SagradaFamilia #Gaudí2026 #CulturalTourism #MICE #BarcelonaArtOfTravel SustainableTourism GloryFacade TowerOfJesusChrist

code.notable: Rare live moment at the top of the Sagrada Familia's scaffolded crystal-like tower with rope-access workers and an orange crane against clear blue sky; newsworthy but not interior content.

reels.caption:
A thousand-year-old inscription, brought into focus.

Silent yet enduring, the Yingxian Wooden Pagoda carries a presence shaped by centuries. With 100 megapixels, the Hasselblad X2D II 100C reveals details that may go unnoticed at first glance, bringing the characters on the ancient plaques into clear view when enlarged.

Every detail brings the architecture a little closer, making it easier to appreciate the craftsmanship and history held within.

📷 X2D II 100C, XCD 35-100E

#Hasselblad #X2DII100C #XCD35100E #100MP #MediumFormat #ArchitecturePhotography #CulturalHeritage
